description: Returns the Cnamio integration guide (Markdown) for adding custom domains to an app: the DNS records with a per-user ownership TXT, the environment variables, the server session route, the browser connect window, the headless API and webhook verification, with the Node.js and Python server SDKs (npm package cnamio, PyPI package cnamio). Framework recipes (Next.js, Express, Rails, Laravel, Django) are listed at https://cnamio.com/llms.txt. Takes no input and needs no credentials.
name: get_integration_guide
title: Cnamio integration guide
